tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The brand field: photo backdrops, logo box, buttons, stickers, big colour blocks. Sampled from the backdrop Junkbox already uses in 14 of 20 Glovo product photos. Never text on surface or surface-raised in Light (1.8:1). Text on amber is on-amber.

tokens.name: amber-press
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an amber button. on-amber text stays on it.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text, the logo letters and icons on amber and amber-press (10.1:1 in both themes). Never white on amber.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The brand black: dark colour blocks, the stamp logo, story backgrounds, price tags. Constant across themes.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ink fields (17.1:1). Amber also reads on ink (10.1:1) for one emphasised word.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for web, menus and listings.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed panels: menu category bands, footer, form wells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on surface: menu cards, order summary.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface, surface-sunk and surface-raised (16:1 or better in both themes). In Dark it is light, so never use it on amber; use on-amber.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Ingredients, weights, captions on surface, surface-sunk and surface-raised (6.2:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges only. Carries no meaning; borders that must be seen use text-muted.

tokens.name: kraft
tokens.usage: Packaging: kraft boxes, bags, fry cups. Use as a ground in mock-ups and print; on-amber (ink) reads on it at 7.9:1.

tokens.name: pickle
tokens.usage: Veggie and fresh only: the ВЕДЖИ tag, the homemade-pickles story. Text on surface and surface-raised (6.2:1 Light, 7.7:1 Dark).

tokens.name: on-pickle
tokens.usage: Text on a pickle fill (6.2:1 Light, 8.8:1 Dark).

tokens.name: chili
tokens.usage: Heat only: the heat meter and the ЛЮТО tag. Never for prices, errors or sales. Text on surface and surface-raised (5.6:1 Light, 6.4:1 Dark).

tokens.name: on-chili
tokens.usage: Text on a chili fill (5.2:1 Light, 7.3:1 Dark).

tokens.name: tag
tokens.usage: Price tag fill on surface and surface-raised. Ink in Light, cream in Dark, so the tag always stands off the page. On photos and post artwork use ink instead.

tokens.name: on-tag
tokens.usage: Price text on tag (17.1:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset. 18:1 on surface in Light, 10:1 in Dark; on an amber button the ring sits outside it, on surface.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per poster, story or hero. Caps. Item names and campaign lines only.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Social post headline, menu board item name.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Section heads on web and printed menus.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Item name on a menu card.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Бриош питка, телешко кюфте Блек Ангъс, зрял чедър.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Домашни кисели краставички, бургер сос, айсберг.
styles.usage: Default running text and item descriptions.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices. Comma decimal, space, then the € sign.

styles.name: ticket
styles.usage: Weights, order numbers, times, ingredient counts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a tag's icon and label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between name and description inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Social template margins at 1080px wide (scaled).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, price tags, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, photo frames, buttons. The box is square-shouldered: never larger on rectangles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Heat-meter segments and round stickers only.

shadow.note: One shadow: the sticker. Hard, offset, no blur, like a sticker slapped on a box. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Price tags, the order button, stickers on social templates. Not on cards.
